content.text:
**答案：2016 年**

《The Express Tribune》2016 年 4 月 12 日在网上发了这篇报道，标题是《AKU becomes country's first hospital to introduce 'Neuro-Robotic Exoscope'》，第二天（4 月 13 日）登上纸质版。原文是："The Aga Khan University hospital (AKUH) has become the first medical centre to introduce the new advanced brain surgery technology, Neuro-Robotic Exoscope, in Pakistan…"。这套设备是 2016 年 4 月 11 日启用的。

依据：
- https://tribune.com.pk/story/1083560/medical-development-aku-becomes-countrys-first-hospital-to-introduce-neuro-robotic-exoscope
- 存档版：https://web.archive.org/web/20211130010011/https://tribune.com.pk/story/1083560/medical-development-aku-becomes-countrys-first-hospital-to-introduce-neuro-robotic-exoscope

同一家报纸 2016 年 9 月 23 日的另一篇报道又提到了这件事，用的是过去时（"In April, … became the first…"）：https://tribune.com.pk/story/1186712/successful-feat-rare-heart-procedure-performed

（共搜了 1 次。）
